jobs.description: Job Title: Python Developer (Django + AWS) Job Summary We are looking for a skilled Python Developer with strong experience in Django and AWS to build, deploy, and maintain scalable web applications. The ideal candidate should have solid backend development skills, experience designing RESTful APIs, and hands-on expertise in cloud-based architectures using AWS. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain web applications using Python and Django framework Design and build RESTful APIs for integration with frontend and third-party services Deploy, manage, and scale applications on AWS cloud infrastructure Work with AWS services such as EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, API Gateway, CloudWatch Develop secure, scalable, and high-performance applications Optimize database queries and ensure efficient data management Collaborate with front-end developers, DevOps teams, and stakeholders Implement authentication, authorization, and data protection mechanisms Write clean, reusable, and testable code Troubleshoot and resolve application issues Participate in code reviews and improve development standards Required Skills & Qualifications Bachelors degree in Computer Science or related field Proven experience as a Python Developer Strong expertise in Django framework Experience in building and consuming REST APIs (Django REST Framework preferred) Hands-on experience with AWS services Strong knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) Familiarity with ORM (Django ORM) Understanding of object-oriented programming (OOP) and design principles Proficiency with Git/version control systems Experience with Linux environments Preferred Skills Experience with serverless architecture (AWS Lambda) Knowledge of Docker and containerization Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, etc.) Experience with microservices architecture Knowledge of NoSQL databases (DynamoDB, MongoDB) Exposure to frontend technologies (React, Angular) is a plus Understanding of caching tools (Redis, Memcached)Role & responsibilities. 3-5 Yrs Django, AWS, Python, Development, Python Development
